The machine description omits the presence of a legend below the chart that labels the colors corresponding to the categories.
The machine description does not mention the label of the vertical axis ('Durchschnitte in %').
The machine description does not mention the label of the horizontal axis ('2000er Jahre', '2010er Jahre', '2020er Jahre').
